lines: Having opened mouth with little fingers, with middle fingers but nose; ring finger wise should crook eyebrow-bend two index fingers.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vidāryāsyaṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu nāsikām anāme kuñcayetprājño bhrūbhaṅgaṃ tarjanīdvayam
